summary: Ubuntu 21.10 (Impish Indri) was released on 14 October 2021. Features: GNOME 40, kernel 5.13, PipeWire for audio. The indri is a large lemur; 'impish' suggested playfulness. GNOME 40 brought a refreshed layout and workflow.
notes: Unsupported since 2022-07-14. Kernel 5.13. PipeWire replaced PulseAudio as the default audio server for better Bluetooth and pro-audio support.
